laura: Postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-1218. Recurring tail-latency spikes after KV-invalidations + sudden client retries. Need temporary SLO window + owners.
laura: Proposal: p95 130ms -> 200ms for 5 weeks, checkpoints at 72h and 2 weeks. Rollback early if p95 < 155ms for 7 consecutive days.
tom (SRE): ok. Also recommend tightening throughput evaluation window to 30s during this period so brief bursts don't burn error budget.
emily: I'll own dashboards and alerts. Will add p95, p99, QPS by pool, KV invalidation rate, and an annotations layer for canary and incident windows.
emily: sample PromQL for p95 by pool:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool))
```
marco: I'll handle the canary + autoscaler smoothing. Plan: staged rollout across pools A->B->C, canary in 4 days. Abort if p99 > 450ms for 10m.
billing-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-1218-FOLLOWUP (#5122).
laura: Action items (please ack when you create PR/ticket links): - Dashboards & alerts (48h): emily - Canary + autoscaler plan (start in 4d): marco - Kernel/serving perf probe (2w): tom - Customer comms draft (72h): laura - SLO governance note + rollback rules (5d): laura
emily: ack. Dashboard PR will include 99p panel and alarm.
marco: ack. Canary plan and rollback script in #5122.
tom (SRE): ack. I'll create perf probe ticket and add a 99p alarm to runbook.
laura: I'll draft comms and hold send until 72h checkpoint barring user-facing regressions.

marco: owned (canary plan linked).

laura: Thanks all. I'll update the SLO governance page after we lock the temporary window and add a 2-week review meeting. If anyone needs to swap, update the ticket or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
